title: ThreatAdaptation
description: The Static's Threat Director adapted its defense to what it suffered (CONTRACTS §6; THREAT-DIRECTOR §4 step 5, C37; NX-156). `UP` when the matching operation launched (escorts appear, air defense is reinforced), `DOWN` when its threat-memory counter has decayed away again. Sector level only: it names no site and updates no facility marker (Q-FOW-17, FOG-OF-WAR FOW-13). Public view: this INTEL line.

side.description: The side whose Director adapted (only the ENEMY's runs until NX-375).

category.description: CONVOY_ESCORT: escorts for convoys after `convoy_attacks`. IADS_REINFORCED: air defense reinforced after `radar_strikes`.
